text.p: Paribas Capital Markets lowered its recommendation on the stock of French hotel group Accor, saying the shares had reached the firm's target.

"The shares have outperformed since our buy recommendation was implemented, rising about 15 percent. They are now at our price relative target, hence our change of stance," it said in a comment issued on Tuesday.
Accor shares were down 0.92 percent at 751 francs at 1250 GMT.
The group recently said it was considering buying Red Roof Inns Inc.

Paribas valued Red Roof Inns at $950 million, including market capitalisation of $502 million and debt of $448 million at the end of September. "This equates to an entreprise value per room of about $35,000...slightly less than that paid by Accor for Motel 6 in 1990," it said.
"A potential issue of perhaps five million Accor shares to acquire Red Roof Inns would put a cap on the recent run in the price, barring a bid for Accor," it said.
